# QueryReply AI — Full Reference

> Automate customer replies with AI that understands your product listings. QueryReply AI delivers accurate, listing specific responses on any website or marketplace.

Canonical URL: https://queryreply.ai/
Contact: hello@queryreply.ai

## Overview

QueryReply AI ("QueryReply") is an AI customer service automation extension for Chromium browsers. Unlike a general-purpose chatbot, it reads the product listing or conversation open in the current browser tab and generates a reply using only that listing's data. This keeps answers accurate across catalogues with many similar products.

Tagline: Reply to Every Customer Automatically, Powered by AI.

## Features

### Product-Aware AI
Reads the active product listing to generate accurate, context-aware customer replies.

### Listing-Specific Responses
Every response is based exclusively on the current product, preventing information from being mixed across different listings.

### Automated Customer Replies
Reduce manual work by generating professional customer responses instantly, without copying product details into AI.

### Works Across Any Platform
Compatible with virtually any marketplace, eCommerce website, or custom business platform, fitting seamlessly into your existing workflow.

## Supported platforms

Works on virtually any website or marketplace. Commonly used on: Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Walmart, ASOS, Shein, Google Play Books, TripAdvisor, Airbnb, WhatsApp Web, Eldorado.gg, Amazon Seller Central, Shopify and custom storefronts.

## Setup

1. **Install the extension** — Add QueryReply AI to your Chromium browser from the Chrome Web Store, then pin it to your toolbar so it is one click away.
2. **Connect a platform** — Open the extension on any supported site — WhatsApp Web, Eldorado.gg, Amazon Seller Central and more — and turn on auto-reply for that platform.
3. **Set your reply rules** — Choose AI Smart Reply for fully automated responses, or write custom rules that fire a specific reply when a keyword appears in an incoming message.
4. **Set your reply limits** — The Free plan allows up to 3 replies per conversation. Paid plans remove that cap, so replies continue for as long as the conversation does.
5. **Monitor and adjust** — Use the extension dashboard to review reply activity and edit rules at any time. Changes apply immediately, with no reinstall.

## Pricing

- **Free — $0/month (free plan)**: Perfect for trying QueryReply AI. Works on 1 website; 1 automated saved reply; No credit card required.
- **Monthly — $5/month**: Best for active sellers. Everything in Free, plus; Works on unlimited websites; 10,000 automated AI replies / month; Custom AI instructions; Faster AI response generation; Priority support; Early access to new features.
- **Enterprise — Custom pricing (contact sales)**: Built for teams and large businesses. Everything in Monthly; Multi-user access; Team management; Custom integrations; Volume-based pricing; Dedicated onboarding; Premium support.

Notes: monthly usage limits reset each billing cycle and unused replies do not roll over. Plans can be upgraded or downgraded at any time.

## Frequently asked questions

### What is QueryReply AI?
QueryReply AI is an AI-powered customer response extension that automatically answers product questions using the exact listing data customers are viewing.

### How does QueryReply AI improve customer support?
It provides instant, accurate, and product-specific replies, helping businesses reduce response time and improve customer satisfaction.

### Why is listing-specific AI important?
It ensures customers receive answers based on the correct product information, preventing confusion and inaccurate responses.

### How is QueryReply AI different from a regular AI chatbot?
Unlike general AI chatbots, QueryReply AI understands individual product listings and generates responses using only relevant product data.

### Can QueryReply AI handle multiple products or listings?
Yes. It keeps each listing's information separate and provides accurate replies across multiple products.

### What type of questions can QueryReply AI answer?
It can answer questions about product details, features, specifications, pricing, availability, policies, and other listing information.

### What happens if the product information is unavailable?
QueryReply AI can inform the customer that the information is unavailable or direct the query for further assistance, rather than guessing.

### Do you store my product data or customer conversations?
No. QueryReply AI does not store your product data or customer conversations. Information is processed only to generate AI responses and is not retained after the request is completed.

### Which platforms does it work on?
QueryReply AI works on virtually any website or marketplace, including major eCommerce platforms, your own store, or a custom platform.

### Is there a free trial?
Yes. You can start with the Free plan, which works on 1 website with 1 automated saved reply, no credit card required, and upgrade whenever you're ready.

### Can I change my plan anytime?
Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your subscription at any time.

### Do unused replies roll over?
No, monthly usage limits reset at the start of each billing cycle.

### Do you support teams?
Yes. The Enterprise plan is designed for teams that manage customer inquiries together, with multi-user access and team management.
